newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius index edges up in lower trading volume.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius index edges up in lower trading volume.

text.p: The share index at the Stock Exchange of Mauritius edged up by 0.58 points to 368.90 on Monday with lower volume in a stable market, bourse officials said.
Turnover fell to 9.34 million rupees on 535,526 shares from 20.09 million rupees on 759,770 shares last Friday. Bourse officials said trading on Monday was quiet with share prices mainly stable.
"Its rather a seasonal effect. It's not the financial reporting season of the companies and during the first few months of every year, things are generally slow," a dealer said.
Mauritius Commercial Bank was unchanged at 85.50 rupees on 20,303 shares and State Bank of Mauritius remained at 11.10 rupees on 211,700 shares.
Mauritius Oil Refineries rose 20 cents to 10.20 rupees on 186,500 shares and building materials manufacturer United Basalt Products eased 10 cents to 34.60 rupees on 3,050 shares.
Conglomerate Rogers rose 50 cents to 98 rupees on 769 shares and national airline Air Mauritius gained 20 cents to 44.20 rupees on 410 shares.
In the hotel sector, Sun Resorts was 40 cents higher to 41.50 rupees on 60,309 shares and Grand Baie hotel was 10 cents higher to 41.10 rupees on 500 shares.
